description: This file defines the DrupalKernelInterface, an interface extending Symfony's HttpKernelInterface, adding methods for managing Drupal's kernel lifecycle, service providers, container, modules, themes, and request handling.

classes.name: DrupalKernelInterface
classes.description: An interface extending Symfony's HttpKernelInterface, adding Drupal-specific methods for kernel management, service providers, container, modules, themes, and request processing.

methods.name: getServiceProviders
methods.description: Returns all registered service providers based on origin ('app' or 'site').

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Gets the current dependency injection container.

methods.name: getCachedContainerDefinition
methods.description: Returns the cached container definition or null.

methods.name: setSitePath
methods.description: Sets the current site path directory.

methods.name: getSitePath
methods.description: Gets the current site path directory.

methods.name: updateModules
methods.description: Updates the list of modules and their filenames.

methods.name: invalidateContainer
methods.description: Invalidates the service container for the next request.
